external_collaboration.evidence_quote: A responsible steward of 11,000 scenic Blue Ridge Mountains acres, the Wintergreen Resort and community actively nurtures its environment, honoring and conserving precious natural resources. Partnering with The Wintergreen Nature Foundation (TWNF), it supports and promotes wildlife habitat preservation and environmental education.

The American Chestnut Tree once comprised a quarter of the eastern hardwood forest from Maine to Georgia and west to the Ohio River Valley, providing valuable economic resources in timber, nuts, and abundant food source for wildlife. Wintergreen Resort has partnered with The American Chestnut Foundation to reintroduce the blight-resistant American chestnut to the forests of the Eastern United States.
